memory:
I believe that maintaining a healthy work-life balance is crucial for success in the financial industry. By prioritizing family and being present in personal relationships, I can ensure that my professional achievements are meaningful and sustainable. My wife's support and encouragement have been instrumental in helping me navigate the demands of running an investment firm while staying connected with my loved ones. I strive to be a role model for my children and make time for them, even when work commitments are intense. By doing so, I can create lasting memories and nurture the relationships that truly matter.

I believe that introducing financial literacy to children is crucial for their future success. By engaging them in discussions about money and investments, I can help them understand the value of hard work and the importance of financial security. My 14-year-old is showing a keen interest in investments and compounding, so I set up a small brokerage account for them to track a few stocks. This will help them develop a hands-on understanding of how investments work. As for my 10-year-old, they're currently more interested in creating a zipline course in the backyard! It's great to see them explore their passions and find joy in life. By instilling financial knowledge and values in my children, I hope to raise them to be responsible and resilient individuals who appreciate the value of money and the importance of hard work.

I believe that financial security is not just about accumulating wealth, but also about protecting and preserving it for the future. My parents, who are now retired, have taught me the importance of financial discipline and long-term planning. They instilled in me a sense of responsibility to ensure their financial well-being during their retirement years. By helping them transition into retirement without financial stress, I have been able to provide them with the security they deserve. It is a reminder that true wealth is not just about material possessions, but about the peace of mind and freedom that comes with knowing that your loved ones are taken care of.

I believe that having a sibling relationship that blends business insight with mutual respect is truly special. My younger sibling is a brilliant and sharp individual who is fully immersed in the tech world. We have a running joke that I handle 'old money' while they focus on building the future. They're always pitching me some AI-driven fintech startup, and I'll counter with a lesson on risk management. This dynamic pushes us to think differently and keeps me connected to the cutting edge of technology in a way that's not just professional, but personal. There's a healthy competitiveness between us, but at the end of the day, we both want to see each other succeed. I don't take this relationship for granted and cherish the opportunity to learn from each other and grow together.

I believe that prioritizing family time is essential for maintaining a healthy work-life balance. By setting aside dedicated time for family activities and trips, I can ensure that my loved ones feel valued and supported. My wife and I have developed a system where we align international business trips with the kids' school breaks, allowing them to experience different cultures while I handle my professional responsibilities. This approach helps me stay present and connected with my family while still meeting my career obligations. It's not always easy, but it's a system that works for us. Ultimately, my family serves as a grounding force, reminding me that wealth is not just about financial success, but about the relationships and experiences that bring joy and fulfillment to our lives.
